instructions.mission: Synthesize multi-LLM validation findings and apply improvements
instructions.constraints: - Do NOT perform web searches or web fetches. Work only from provided files. - Be concise. Focus on applying improvements, not verbose analysis.

steps.step: Cross-reference findings from all validators. Determine validity of each finding. Note areas of consensus and disagreement.

Assign severity to each validated finding: - Critical: Must fix before development - High: Should fix, significant impact - Medium: Recommended improvement - Low: Nice to have
Document any false positives from validators.
Apply validated improvements directly to the story file. Log all changes made. Use atomic writes to prevent corruption.

Create synthesis report and save it to {report_dir}/{story_key}-validation-synthesis.md
Report must include: - Agreed findings across validators - Unique findings from individual validators - Disputed findings with resolution - Quality metrics (actionable_ratio, specificity_score, evidence_quality)
IMPORTANT: Create the {report_dir} directory if it does not exist. Do NOT write reports to any other location.
Verify all Critical and High issues are addressed. Confirm story consistency after changes.
